0022600026.text: The Hornets (3-6, on a five-game losing streak and 10th in the East) host the Celtics (6-2, on a one-game winning streak and 3rd in the East) in East Group C of the Emirates NBA Cup, with Charlotte 2-3 at home and Boston 5-0 at home. Charlotte is without Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), both out, while Dennis Schroder (thigh) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day with game-time decisions; Boston is without Devin Carter (illness), who is out, and Payton Pritchard (eye abrasion) is day-to-day with a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost 1-2 to Boston in the 2025-26 season series, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026.
